gain.title: 1 · Gain calibration
gain.method: long moves of whole electrical periods and whole screw revolutions, both directions; fit the slope

staircase.title: 2 · Microstep staircase
staircase.purpose: static error map vs electrical phase, and hysteresis
staircase.method: quasi-static staircase through 2 electrical periods forward then back, 0.75 s per microstep, at 3 locations

settling.title: 3 · Point-to-point settling matrix
settling.purpose: the main metric: where it actually stops
settling.method: trapezoidal moves in randomised order over distance x speed x direction, 2-5 s dwell after each stop

repeatability.title: 4 · Bidirectional repeatability
repeatability.method: ISO 230-2 style: 5 targets along travel, approached from both sides, 5 repeats
